Use business keys and company/country scope; do not hardcode database IDs in cross-database module defaults.
Historical source fields stay as provenance; no automatic creation of active resignations/assets/approvals from imported text.
Only apply Rize mappings in rize; ship reusable provider capabilities to installed modules in all four active databases.
Keep disabled/unconfigured system providers unavailable, not zero.
Set leave paid percentage explicitly; labels and unpaid flags alone are insufficient.
System mode excludes current and stale spreadsheet data; uploaded mode follows explicit configured precedence.
Existing mappings are preserved for compatibility, not certified as the final domain owner.
Read-only computed values and approval-derived states are payroll sources, never raw import destinations.
Source-only fields preserve immutable evidence and require reconciliation before changing canonical records.
Contractual mode defaults to work-calendar divisor with an optional fixed override; paid leave is included once, and approved cash-out is separate.
Approved timesheets are reconciled with attendance and daily snapshots are clipped to the payroll period.
Apply detailed country policy clauses over summary table, literally until revised; flag external-policy discrepancies for review without automatic substitution.
